title: AI & Automation Engineer
description:
**AI Automation Engineer**

**About the Role**

We're looking for an AI Automation Engineer to help DIPL and our clients work smarter with AI. You'll build workflow automations and generative AI solutions, help every department use AI effectively, and act as a link between our clients' business goals and what AI can do for them. You'll also represent our automation offerings in client conversations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build workflow automations and GenAI solutions using tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini)
* Work with each department to find repetitive tasks and automate them to improve productivity
* Train team members to use AI tools and maintain simple automations on their own
* Research and resolve AI and automation issues raised by internal teams
* Understand client challenges and requirements, and prepare AI solution strategies and roadmaps that fit their business objectives
* Create workflow demos and proofs of concept for prospective clients
* Join demo and technical calls with clients interested in workflow automation, as a product or as a service
* Work with the sales team on solution scoping, effort estimation, and costing
* Own the client journey from discovery to implementation and support
* Explain technical possibilities in simple, business-friendly language to decision-makers
* Document workflows, prompts, and best practices in a shared knowledge base
* Keep up with AI trends and tools, and recommend the ones worth adopting

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc. (IT/CS) or equivalent
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript
* Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON
* Hands-on experience with any automation platform (n8n, Make, Zapier) through projects or internships
* Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, and basic RAG or chatbot concepts
* Good understanding of AI concepts and tools (e.g., NLP, ML, chatbots, automation, cloud technologies)
* Some hands-on experience in AI projects, through execution, coordination, or implementation
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to manage multiple client engagements
* Strong problem-solving mindset, with the ability to turn business needs into AI opportunities
* Flexibility to work with international clients, especially in US time zones as needed

**Good to Have**

* Experience with LangChain, vector databases, or AI agent frameworks
* Basic SQL and cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Exposure to CRM/ERP integrations
* A portfolio, GitHub, or demo projects showing automations you've built
* Prior training or presentation experience

**What We Offer**

* Hands-on mentoring and a structured learning path
* Exposure to real client projects and pre-sales
* A chance to shape AI adoption across the company
* Growth into a senior AI solutions role

Work Location: In person

title: QA( Manual + Automation )
description:
**What's the work?**

Love finding bugs before they cause trouble? Passionate about making software smooth and reliable? Then this role is for you!

At Saleshandy, we're on a mission to achieve 100% automation by the end of the year - and we need you to help us get there! As our Junior QA Engineer, you'll test features, automate workflows, and work with developers to keep our products running flawlessly.

**Who Are We Looking For? - SDET 1**  
  

* 1-2 years of hands-on experience in QA / SDET role
* Strong understanding of web application testing, REST API testing, and API workflows
* Knowledge of SDLC, STLC, Agile methodologies, and test design techniques
* 1-2 years of hands-on experience with Playwright for test automation.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript
* Experience in building and maintaining automation frameworks using:
* BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) approach (e.g., Cucumber with Playwright)
* Page Object Model (POM)
* Ability to write clean, scalable, and maintainable automation scripts
* Experience integrating automation tests with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.)
* Hands-on experience in API testing using Postman
* Comfortable writing and validating SQL queries (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.)
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git, GitHub, GitLab)
* Exposure to AI-powered testing tools and practices, such as:
* Using ChatGPT / GitHub Copilot for test generation
* Self-healing automation and intelligent locators
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Good communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to take ownership and work in a fast-paced environment

  
**Nice to have:**  

* Knowledge of performance testing (JMeter)
* Knowledge of security testing (OWASP Top 10)
